paper_language: Neqo-inspired and Chromium-inspired modeled receiver ACK policies

neqo-like-ack.modeled_scope: receiver ACK generation for one QUIC connection; explicit application-data state plus immediate Initial and Handshake ACKs
neqo-like-ack.ack_eliciting_definition: quic-go transport frames other than ACK, PADDING, and CONNECTION_CLOSE; packets containing any other frame are ACK-eliciting

parameters.rtt_deadline: min(first-pending-ack-eliciting-receive-time+20ms,last-ACK-send-time+smoothed-RTT) when last ACK and SRTT exist
parameters.out_of_order_immediate_ack: packet-number is not the next in-order application packet number
parameters.state_reset: new connection creates new trackers; no modeled migration reset within a connection

unsupported_native_behavior: Neqo frame-specific immediate-ACK decisions such as PING are not separately modeled because quic-go supplies packet-level ACK-eliciting metadata rather than the pinned Neqo frame classification at this decision point
native Firefox preferences, release channel configuration, and browser scheduling
Neqo ACK range retention and ACK encoding implementation details

chrome-like-ack.modeled_scope: receiver ACK generation for one QUIC connection using pinned QUICHE default application-data ACK decimation behavior; not a Chrome browser claim
chrome-like-ack.ack_eliciting_definition: quic-go transport frames other than ACK, PADDING, and CONNECTION_CLOSE; packets containing any other frame are ACK-eliciting

parameters.transition_counter: application-data ACK-eliciting packet-number position relative to the least-observed application packet number; not received-packet count or ACK count
parameters.boundary_packet_uses: new steady state threshold and timer
parameters.new_gap_immediate_ack_scope: first four received packets in the newest packet-number range after a gap
parameters.ecn_ce_immediate_ack: only on transition from non-CE to CE
parameters.state_reset: new connection creates new trackers; no modeled migration reset within a connection

unsupported_native_behavior: QUICHE connection options for 1/8 RTT delay, unlimited ACK decimation, and one-immediate-ACK modes
native Chrome field trials, browser process scheduling, and release configuration
QUICHE crypto packet-number-space delayed ACK implementation details because paper-v1 intentionally uses immediate Initial and Handshake ACKs
